+def _parse_int(value, name: str) -> int:
+    """Parse *value* as an integer.
+
+    This helper converts configuration values that may be strings to int.
+    Raises a clear ValueError if conversion fails."""
+    try:
+        return int(value)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an integer, got {value!r}") from exc
+

diff --git a/agixt/tests/test_websearch_depth.py b/agixt/tests/test_websearch_depth.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5fa8e8b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/agixt/tests/test_websearch_depth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import pytest
+from agixt.Websearch import _parse_int
+
+def test_parse_int_from_string():
+    assert _parse_int("3", "websearch_depth") == 3
+
+def test_parse_int_from_int():
+    assert _parse_int(5, "websearch_depth") == 5
+
+def test_parse_int_invalid():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc:
+        _parse_int("bad", "websearch_depth")
+    assert "websearch_depth must be an integer" in str(exc.value)
